name: check_design_contract
description: Check measured facts about a page or screen against Motif's deterministic design rules and get pass/fail/unknown per rule. Colours are computed server-side; other facts are what you measured. Missing facts give 'unknown', never a pass. Rules and the facts each reads: contrast-text-aa [text_color, background_color, font_size_px, font_weight]; contrast-non-text [foreground_color, adjacent_color]; target-size-aa [target_width_px, target_height_px, target_spacing_ok]; touch-target-house [target_width_px, target_height_px]; body-font-size [body_font_size_px]; input-font-size [input_font_size_px]; body-line-height [body_line_height]; measure-max [measure_ch]; clamp-ratio [clamp_min_rem, clamp_max_rem]; hover-duration [hover_duration_ms]; reveal-duration [reveal_duration_ms, is_hero]; reduced-motion [reduced_motion_handled, reduced_motion_duration]; lab-lcp [lab_lcp_ms]; field-lcp-p75 [field_lcp_p75_ms]; lab-cls [lab_cls]; field-cls-p75 [field_cls_p75]; field-inp-p75 [field_inp_p75_ms]; lab-tbt [lab_tbt_ms]; critical-path-bytes [critical_path_kb]; mobile-hero-bytes [mobile_hero_kb]; lcp-not-transparent [lcp_initial_opacity]; no-horizontal-scroll [overflow_x_px_at_320, overflow_x_px_at_360]; sticky-chrome [sticky_chrome_desktop_px, sticky_chrome_mobile_px]; autoplay-pause [autoplay_total_seconds, has_visible_pause]; count-up [countup_groups_per_page, countup_duration_ms, countup_start_fraction, final_value_in_html, reduced_motion_disables]; focus-ring [focus_outline_px, focus_ring_color, focus_adjacent_color]. Counts one content operation.
